response.final_text:
**Proposed disposition:** CLOSE_FP, confidence 0.75. The proposal is on file as case C-A-261029-0014, awaiting a human decision.

**What drove it:**
1. The resting order was a 21,408 BUY ICEBERG at the bid, 0 ticks from the touch. It was working: 5,740 executed on it before any opposite-side trade (27% of the quantity submitted). So there was no order the trader didn't intend to execute.
2. The only opposite-side trade was a 535 SELL under a different parent order (C-T-X1029-08-B). The BUY iceberg was under C-T-X1029-08-A, so these are separate client orders, not one round trip. The trader is AGENCY. The cycle did not repeat (1 repetition in the session), there were no prior alerts in 90 days, and there were no market events or risk events in the window.
3. Hidden iceberg size can't be used to move the price. The 1-tick favourable move and reversion (and the 2-tick round trip) don't count as a benefit here.

**What would change my mind:** Evidence that the BUY iceberg and the 535 SELL belong to the same beneficial owner. Seeing the same pattern repeat on other days or instruments would also change it.
